summary: Two-day search for a vehicle reported rolled on Indian Mountain after the occupants called a spouse saying one of them was pinned under the vehicle and injured; unable to give a location, the driver walked out to Tarryall Reservoir and a deputy transported him back to the vehicle, where the other occupant was found uninjured; circumstances deemed suspicious and handled by the sheriff's department
responding_agency: Park County SAR; Park County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Parks and Wildlife
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: exact date not given; The Flume's mid-Aug 2016 PCSAR Happenings roundup places this two-day search between its end-of-July MTB incident and its Aug-1 bee-sting item, i.e. very late July 2016. Resolves the run-42 pending Indian Mountain lead.
